title: Sprinto subprocessors, DPA & security · Third Party Index
markdown: # SSprinto [sprinto.com](https://sprinto.com/) Sprinto declares [16 subprocessors](https://thirdpartyindex.com/vendors/sprinto#subprocessors) in [its subprocessor list](https://trust.sprinto.com/subprocessors), which we last checked on Nov 10, 2026 ( [evidence](https://thirdpartyindex.com/evidence/218197)). They include [Amazon Web Services](https://thirdpartyindex.com/vendors/amazon-web-services), [Google Cloud](https://thirdpartyindex.com/vendors/google-cloud) and [OpenAI](https://thirdpartyindex.com/vendors/openai). No published changes since we first read it on Nov 5, 2026. [6 tracked vendors](https://thirdpartyindex.com/vendors/sprinto#used-by) name Sprinto as a subprocessor, including [ClearMash](https://thirdpartyindex.com/vendors/clearmash), [Compliance.tf](https://thirdpartyindex.com/vendors/compliance-tf) and [DigiUsher](https://thirdpartyindex.com/vendors/digiusher).
